    AI Overview
    In March 2026, Trader Joe's and manufacturer Ajinomoto Foods expanded a massive recall to
    over 9 million pounds of frozen, ready-to-eat products—including Chicken Fried Rice, Vegetable Fried Rice, Japanese Style Fried Rice, and Chicken Shu Mai—due to potential contamination with foreign objects, specifically glass fragments. 
    Affected Products (Check Best By Dates): 
    • Chicken Fried Rice: 03/04/2026 through 02/10/2027
    • Vegetable Fried Rice: 02/28/2026 through 11/19/2026
    • Japanese Style Fried Rice: 02/28/2026 through 11/14/2026
    • Chicken Shu Mai: 03/13/2026 through 10/23/2026 
    Key Details: 
    • Reason: Potential glass contamination (1-3 cm long, 2-4 mm wide).
    • Action: Consumers should not eat these products; discard them or return them to any Trader Joe’s for a full refund.
    • Distribution: Nationwide (43 states reported), with some products also exported to Canada and Mexico.
    • Risk: The USDA initially classified this as a Class I recall, meaning there is a reasonable probability of serious adverse health consequences. 
    The recall was sparked by customer complaints and is believed to have originated from a vegetable source ingredient. No injuries have been officially reported to date.
